ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Which of the following preys on aquatic crustaceans?
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, containing labels such as Raccoons, Ducks, Fish, Minnows, Aquatic crustaceans, Algae and floating plants. Aquatic crustaceans are located at the lower left, and Fish are located above them and slightly to the left; there is an arrow from Aquatic crustaceans pointing to Fish. Reasoning: The question asks what preys on aquatic crustaceans. According to the convention in food webs that arrows go from the eaten to the predator, Aquatic crustaceans pointing to Fish indicates that Fish eat or prey on aquatic crustaceans. Therefore the answer is fish.
